actor.herbalist.description: Poisons, vials, herbs and quick knife attacks instead of brute force.
actor.herbalist.name: Herbalist
actor.lost_psychopath.description: Uses stress as power, but risks collapse if pushed too far.
actor.lost_psychopath.name: Lost Psychopath
actor.masochist.description: One actor of the pair. Takes pain from the Sadist and turns it into resources.
actor.masochist.name: Masochist
actor.merchant.description: Buys progression with gold, skips normal card rewards and treats poverty as a design flaw.
actor.merchant.name: Merchant
actor.monk.description: Switches stances and gains power through the correct rhythm of entering and leaving them.
actor.monk.name: Monk
actor.replicant.description: A heavily augmented cyborg who creates drones and amplifies them with enemy marks.
actor.replicant.name: Replicant
actor.rusted_knight.description: An aggressive shield fighter: builds Strength, survives with block and pays health for pressure.
actor.rusted_knight.name: Rusted Knight
actor.sadist.description: One actor of the pair. Hurts the Masochist and gains leverage from controlled cruelty.
actor.sadist.name: Sadist
archetype.herbalist.details_description: The Herbalist plays through poison, vials and many small attacks. She is weaker in blunt direct trades, but strong in long fights: poison pressures enemies every turn, knives finish targets and field medicine helps her survive the slow ramp.
archetype.herbalist.name: Herbalist
archetype.herbalist.palette: Green palette: herbs, poison, swamp and natural tones.
archetype.herbalist.short_description: Poison tactics: poison, small knife attacks, vials and field medicine.
archetype.herbalist.strength.poison: Strong in long fights through poison and area poison.
archetype.herbalist.strength.small_attac: Small attacks and multi-hit cards pair well with future on-hit effects.
archetype.herbalist.unique_mechanic: First working version: poison is the main scaling source, and the starter relic draws 1 card the first time you apply poison each combat. Multi-hit knife cards are prepared for future on-hit effects.
archetype.herbalist.visual_identity: Silhouette: herb bags, belts with vials, flasks, small knives and alchemist or field-medic gloves. She should look like someone who heals and kills with the same toolkit, because nature is not especially kind either.
archetype.herbalist.weakness.slow_start: Slow to ramp and weaker against fast incoming damage.
archetype.lost_psychopath.details_descri: The Lost Psychopath uses stress as a power source. The higher his stress, the more dangerous he becomes, but the closer he gets to breakdown and stress death.
archetype.lost_psychopath.name: Lost Psychopath
archetype.lost_psychopath.palette: Gray palette: dust, fog, dirty cloth and dull metal.
archetype.lost_psychopath.short_descript: Gray risk mechanic: stress empowers him, but leads toward collapse.
archetype.lost_psychopath.strength.risk_: Can pressure enemies when other characters would already be falling apart.
archetype.lost_psychopath.unique_mechani: Mechanic plan: stress grants combat bonuses by ranges, for example 50+, 100+ and 150+, but high values introduce unstable penalties: random discard, self-damage, loss of control or enemy buffs.
archetype.lost_psychopath.visual_identit: Silhouette: lost, worn down, nervous, with signs of long wandering and inner collapse. He should not look like a “cool madman”; he is dangerous because he is barely holding together.
archetype.lost_psychopath.weakness.insta: High stress creates risk of breakdown, death and future unstable effects.
archetype.merchant.details_description: The Merchant is built around money. He does not receive normal card rewards, but gains more gold and turns shops, rest sites and card costs into the main progression tools.
archetype.merchant.name: Merchant
archetype.merchant.palette: Yellow palette: gold, brass, dirty coins and warm shop light.
archetype.merchant.short_description: Yellow economy: gold instead of normal rewards and purchases instead of luck.
archetype.merchant.strength.shop_control: Controls progression better through purchases and shops.
archetype.merchant.unique_mechanic: Normal combats grant 35% more gold but no card rewards. Instead of a standard rest, the Merchant buys up to 2 cards from 5 offered cards at a 15% discount. Some cards may spend gold when played.
archetype.merchant.visual_identity: Silhouette: purses, scales, coin bags, travel cloak and possibly a portable stall or display case. He should not look like a hero, but like someone who sells heroism on installments with unpleasant interest.
archetype.merchant.weakness.no_card_rewa: Does not get normal post-combat card rewards.
archetype.merchant.weakness.shop_depende: Highly dependent on shops and economy.
archetype.monk.details_description: The Monk plays through stances that change the rules of the current fight. Flame increases outgoing damage but increases incoming damage. Ash improves block but reduces damage. Smoke reduces incoming damage. Switching from one stance to another grants 1 energy and draws 2 cards.
archetype.monk.name: Monk
archetype.monk.palette: Purple palette: dusk, inner tension and mystical cold.
archetype.monk.short_description: Purple rhythm: stances, entering, leaving and changing combat modes.
archetype.monk.strength.stances: Can change combat rules through stances.
archetype.monk.unique_mechanic: Exactly one stance can be active. The first stance sets the combat mode, and every later stance switch grants tempo: +1 energy and draw 2 cards. The Monk is strongest when he chooses the right stance before the enemy acts.
archetype.monk.visual_identity: Silhouette: simple monk clothing, rigid posture, signs of discipline and contained fury. He should look calm only enough for the player to understand that someone is about to make a mistake, and it will be the enemy.
archetype.monk.weakness.misstance: The wrong stance can sharply punish a turn.
archetype.replicant.details_description: The Replicant is a human whose organs are mostly replaced by prosthetics. He plays through drones: each drone passively triggers at the end of your turn, while activation cards spend the drone for a stronger effect.
archetype.replicant.name: Replicant
archetype.replicant.palette: Blue palette: cold metal, surgical light and electric accents.
archetype.replicant.short_description: Blue cyborg: prosthetics, drones, marks and delayed value.
archetype.replicant.strength.marks: Marks focus drone damage onto key targets.
archetype.replicant.unique_mechanic: Drones occupy slots, stay in combat, and passively act at the end of the player turn. The player cannot activate drones directly: only activation cards can spend a drone and apply its stronger effect. Drone marks increase drone damage against the marked target specifically.
archetype.replicant.visual_identity: Silhouette: asymmetrical prosthetics, mechanical organs, cables, connection ports and small drones near the body. He should not look like a sleek superhero cyborg, but like a person assembled back together with an alarming quantity of spare parts.
archetype.replicant.weakness.slot_pressu: Must carefully manage drone slots and order.
archetype.rusted_knight.details_descript: The Rusted Knight is a basic but not toothless archetype. He plays around Strength, block, and risky cards that spend HP or add temporary exposure. His job is to survive the first hit, scale up, and end the fight before his own armor collapses out of enthusiasm.
archetype.rusted_knight.name: Rusted Knight
archetype.rusted_knight.palette: Orange palette: rust, warm metal and burned ochre.
archetype.rusted_knight.short_descriptio: A heavy aggressor: builds Strength, blocks with a shield, and spends HP for tempo.
archetype.rusted_knight.strength.block_p: Can combine shield defense with enemy pressure.
archetype.rusted_knight.strength.risk_re: Risky cards trade HP or temporary exposure for high tempo.
archetype.rusted_knight.strength.strengt: Builds Strength quickly and converts it into high damage.
archetype.rusted_knight.unique_mechanic: The Rusted Knight powers attacks through Strength and gets value from defensive cards. Some of his cards are deliberately dangerous: they spend HP or add Weak/Vulnerable in exchange for damage, block, draw, or energy.
archetype.rusted_knight.visual_identity: Silhouette: heavy shield, old rusted armor and marks of long fights. He should look dangerous, worn down and stubborn, not like a shiny noble knight from a brochure for heroic death.
archetype.rusted_knight.weakness.self_ex: Often has to take damage to keep tempo and scaling.
archetype.rusted_knight.weakness.status_: Weak and Vulnerable punish his aggressive turns especially hard.
archetype.sadist_masochist.details_descr: One character pick creates two separate actors: Sadist and Masochist. They have separate health, resources and relics. Their power comes from controlled violence between them, which is a balancing nightmare, but at least an honest one.
archetype.sadist_masochist.name: Sadist & Masochist
archetype.sadist_masochist.palette: Red palette: blood, leather, dark metal and painful contrast.
archetype.sadist_masochist.short_descrip: Red paired archetype: two actors, pain, mutual bonuses and risk.
archetype.sadist_masochist.strength.pain: Pain between characters becomes Strength and Dexterity.
archetype.sadist_masochist.strength.two_: Two bodies create flexible threat and resource distribution.
archetype.sadist_masochist.unique_mechan: The Sadist gains bonuses when damaging the Masochist. The Masochist gains bonuses when damaged by the Sadist. This logic should live through damage events, not hardcoded inside DamageSystem.
archetype.sadist_masochist.visual_identi: The Sadist should read through an aggressive silhouette and tools like a whip, hooks or straps. The Masochist should look more visibly wounded: scars, bandages and traces of old pain. The hard part is not turning it into a cheap basement caricature, despite humanity’s many contributions to that genre.
archetype.sadist_masochist.weakness.comp: Requires careful management of two actors.
archetype.sadist_masochist.weakness.low_: Each actor is individually more fragile than a normal hero.

archetype.replicant.weakness.delayed_val: He needs time to fill slots and reach full value.
